fact: ANIP's mobile app includes Seyna, an AI-built chatbot that answers frequently asked questions and helps users make requests, presented at a press conference on 14 February 2025.

La Marina BJ reports that GPT BJ, the government's virtual assistant launched in 2023, answers citizens' questions on the tax, digital, labour and penal codes, and that the agency ASIN is preparing an expansion funded by the national budget.
The Agence des Systèmes d'Information et du Numérique (ASIN) opened a tender on 24 June 2024 for a platform of conversational assistants and GPT BJ use cases, with bids due 25 July 2024.

The ministry says the government implemented GPT.BJ, a chatbot developed by the Benin Agency for Information Systems and Digital that answers citizens' questions on the tax, digital, labour and penal codes, launched in 2023.

Levellers says the Agence des Systemes d'Information et du Numerique (ASIN) built GPT BJ, a government chatbot answering questions on the tax, digital, labour and penal codes, presented on 11 May 2023.
